title: Create src/tui/RocketLoopApp.tsx — main loop TUI orchestrator
description: Create the root Ink component for the rocket loop TUI. Manages a state machine that transitions through: task selection, running, complete, blocked, and decide states.
acceptanceCriteria: RocketLoopApp starts in 'selecting' state showing TaskSelector
Transitions to 'running' state when a task is selected
Transitions to 'complete' state when loop emits complete event
Transitions to 'blocked' state when loop emits blocked event
Transitions to 'decide' state when loop emits decide event
Running state shows IterationHeader and SpinnerPreview

steps.details: Create the file. Define state type: type AppState = 'selecting' | 'running' | 'complete' | 'blocked' | 'decide'. Use useState for state management.
When state === 'selecting': render <TaskSelector tasks={tasks} onSelect={handleTaskSelect} />. handleTaskSelect sets the selected task and transitions to 'running'.

steps.description: Render running state with IterationHeader and SpinnerPreview
steps.details: When state === 'running': render <Box flexDirection='column'><IterationHeader n={currentIteration} max={maxIterations} taskId={selectedTask.id} /><SpinnerPreview lines={outputLines} /></Box>
When state === 'complete': render <CompletionReport />. When state === 'blocked': render <BlockedScreen />. When state === 'decide': render <DecideScreen />.

technicalNotes: This is the top-level React component rendered by Ink — it owns all the state for the loop session
State machine pattern prevents invalid state combinations (e.g., showing completion report while still running)
